tissue.evidence: Of note, AZ521 is a duodenal adenocarcinoma cell line, but since pyloric gland‐type adenocarcinoma of the duodenum showing gastric‐type differentiation has been reported, we included this cell line for proteome analysis, consistent with the DepMap and the Cancer Cell Line Encyclopedia (CCLE) databases classifying it as GC under the disease category.
